definition: For each individually fixed ball identifier b there is a possibly b-dependent cutoff stage after which b is absent. In the simplified urn, stage n contains balls n+1 through 2n.
note: The mathematical example isolates a pointwise limit-of-membership interpretation; no empirical infinite physical urn or historically sourced attribution is asserted. The ten-to-one historical illustration is separate from the deliberately two-to-one Lean model.
